lines.trans: Wake up, Lyova, we have an inspection!
Chef, the inspector is already entering the hall!
Quickly clear everything extra off the tables.
Where to hide these old products?
Carry all this straight into the refrigerator.
And what to do with dirty aprons?
Lyova, immediately throw them into the wash!
I already sent Senya for cloths.
Wipe the floor, it is too slippery!
The cooks are already washing their workstations.
The kitchen must be ideally clean!
We will manage to do everything in time, chef!
